newsitem.title: USA: Prime Retail in Ohio venture with Salomon.
newsitem.headline: Prime Retail in Ohio venture with Salomon.

text.p: Prime Retail Inc said Tuesday it secured a $32.9 million mortgage loan commitment and formed a joint venture partnership with Salomon Brothers Realty Corp to develop Buckeye Factory Shops in Ohio.
Phase I of the Burbank, Ohio, project, which will contain about 205,000 square feet of space for leasing, is under construction. Phase I is expected to open November 15.
Phase II of the project will contain about 103,000 square feet of space for leasing. It will begin within 18 months after the opening of the first phase.
Under the joint venture agreement, Prime Retail will hold capital interests of 75 percent, while Salomon Brothers will hold the remaining 25 percent.
